worldcombat.skill.wish.summary: Sends a wish star high up; after a delay it falls back where it was cast and restores a share of the caster's maximum health. With Sharing on, friendly combatants in the landing ring also receive 60 percent of their base heal. The star exists on its own, so it still lands where it was cast even if the caster leaves.
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.0: Lay down a delayed heal in advance
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.2: Share the wish: everyone in the ring gets 60 percent of their base heal (not split by headcount)
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.0: The wish star lands %1$s after it is sent, restoring %2$s of the caster's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.1: The landing ring has a radius of %1$s blocks. With Sharing on, the caster and each friendly combatant inside the ring receive %2$s of their base healing amount.
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.share: Sharing wish: the caster and allies within the landing ring each receive %1$s of their base healing amount. The caster still receives healing after moving away.
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.self: Selfish wish: the star pays out only to the caster at the full fraction and heals no ally.
worldcombat.skill.wish.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: heal yourself and allies in the landing ring for 60% of each base healing amount; moving away does not prevent your own healing. Off: heal only yourself for the full base amount.
worldcombat.skill.wish.preference.ai.hea: Below this health ratio the companion sends the wish early; lower endures longer, higher spends a delayed heal at the first wound.
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.payou: At payout the caster is healed as long as they are alive, no matter how far they have moved; only shared allies are chosen by the landing ring. Anyone already at full health or already down is not healed, and if no one benefits the wish is wasted.
